svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Body 146 long x 21 wide x 165 tall; a 9 mm slot inside holds the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6 mm plate with 1.5 mm each side; front wall 3 mm, others 6 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: On top: a collar 80 x 48 x 20 with a 68 x 38 pocket, 10 deep, and a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: funnel from 60 x 30 down to the 60 x 9 slot. The hopper neck drops in.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chain side: a 22 mm hole for the plate hub; two lugs 20 x 37 x 25 with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6.5 mm holes and an M6 nut slot, 35 mm each side of the shaft.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Door side: an opening 128 x 132; two M4 heat-set inserts for the door.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rear wall: a 9 x 10 slot 35 to 45 mm above the shaft for the brush.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Under the outlet: a spigot 16 mm outside, 12 mm bore, 60 long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print standing on its bottom face; support the lugs and collar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: lugs on the chain-side rail's inside face, on the bearing plate

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bolts; the plate turns in the slot without touching.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 6 mm plate turns in the slot with the door on.
